questions.stem: A patient was put on Fluoxetine for moderate depression. The physician preferred Fluoxetine over TCAs for the following reasons except:

options.label: A
options.text: Less/ nil Muscarinic or alpha blockade

questions.solutionHtml:
Less interference with sexual activity

Advantages of SSRIs over TCAS

  • Block reuptake of serotonin reuptake only into serotonergic nerve endings
  • No Muscarinic or alpha blockade
  • Low CVS side effects--arrhythmias
  • Negligible anticholinergic side effects--elderly
  • Less sedation and weight gain
  • No interference with cognitive/psychomotor function
  • No postural Hypotension
  • But sexual side effects are as common as TCA.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:487

questions.stem: A person was under depression and was put on Fluoxetine therapy. Which of the following is likely to be caused by Fluoxetine therapy?
questions.solutionHtml:
Sexual dysfunction
  • SSRIs Adverse effects
  • GIT( Due to 5HT3 Stimulation) :
    • Nausea( MC Complaint)
    • GIT upset, diarrhea
    • Anxiety
  • Sexual dysfunction:
    • Loss of libido, delayed orgasm, or diminished arousal (Anorgasmia)

erectile dysfunction and ejaculatory delay

o CNS:

o Sleep disturbances. For this reason, fluoxetine is usually administered in the morning after breakfast

o vivid dreams

Note

Nausea (MC Complaint) > Anxiety > diarrhea

questions.stem: Assume you've been posted to the Psychiatry Department as a resident doctor. A patient with tardive dyskinesia who was using atypical antidepressants came in for a consultation. Which of the following medicines has a chance of causing extrapyramidal side effects like tardive dyskinesia?
questions.solutionHtml:
Amoxapine
  • Amoxapine This tetracyclic compound is unusual in that it blocks dopamine D2 receptors in addition to inhibiting A reuptake.
  • It is chemically related to the antipsychotic drug loxapine and has mixed antidepressant + neuroleptic properties;
  • may be used for patients with psychotic depression unresponsive to other antidepressants.
  • Risk of extrapyramidal side effects is also there. Seizures (including status epilepticus) occur in its overdose.
